name: Fist Bump
summary: Flat die-cut two fists meeting knuckle to knuckle over a small impact burst, for teamwork and good job moments.

params.name: s
params.note: scale; about 620 px wide at s = 1

params.name: skin
params.note: hand colour; a SKIN name from the style (light, fair, tan, medium, brown, dark) or any hex

params.name: anim
params.note: bump pushes the fists together on a beat; shake trembles

params.name: popIn
params.note: springs in over the first 10 frames

author: krakujs
